name: krafty-sprouts/sharely
label: Sharely
description: Share buttons in your articles and a floating share bar, follow buttons, highlight-to-share, Pinterest pins and a share report. Counts share clicks on your own site without cookies or addresses. Only if you turn them on, asks Facebook, Pinterest, Reddit or Hacker News for an article's share count, and Bitly for short links.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

settingsSections.label: Networks
settingsSections.description: Each network on or off, in the order you put them.

settingsSections.label: How the buttons look
settingsSections.description: Drawn with your theme's own colours and spacing.

settings.label: Buttons in articles
settings.description: Where the share buttons sit in an article.

settings.label: Content types
settings.description: The kinds of item that get share buttons.

settings.label: Other content types
settings.description: The keys of any other content types, separated by commas.

settings.label: Floating bar
settings.description: A bar of share buttons that stays on screen. A side bar shows only on screens wide enough for it.

settings.label: Heading
settings.description: A line above the buttons in articles. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Share buttons
settings.description: The networks, in the order they show.

fields.label: Network
fields.description: The network or tool this button shares to.

settings.label: More button after
settings.description: Show this many buttons, then a More button that opens the rest. 0 shows them all.

settings.label: A different set on phones
settings.description: Show other buttons on small screens, such as WhatsApp and the device's own share menu.

settings.label: Share buttons on phones
settings.description: The networks small screens show, in order.

fields.label: Network
fields.description: The network or tool this button shares to.

settings.label: Phone screens are narrower than
settings.description: Below this width the phone set shows; from it, the main set.

settings.label: Shape
settings.description: The buttons' corners.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the buttons are.

settings.label: Labels
settings.description: Whether the buttons show the network's name beside its icon. Every button is named for screen readers either way.

settings.label: Colours
settings.description: Network colours, your site's accent from Settings › Design, or quiet outlined buttons in your theme's text colour.

settings.label: Alignment
settings.description: Where the row of buttons sits.

settings.label: Count share clicks
settings.description: Counts each click on a share button on your own site: the article, the network and the day. No cookies, no addresses, nothing about the reader.

settings.label: Show counts on the buttons
settings.description: Shows how often an article was shared.

settings.label: Show the total
settings.description: Shows the total number of shares beside the buttons.

settings.label: Hide counts below
settings.description: No number shows until an article has been shared this many times.

settings.label: Ask networks for their counts
settings.description: Once a day or as often as you choose, a background job asks the networks you tick below how often each article was shared there. It sends them each article's address. Never while a page loads.

settings.label: Networks to ask
settings.description: Facebook needs an access token. Pinterest's and Reddit's counts come from addresses they don't promise to keep.

settings.label: How often
settings.description: How often the counts are asked for.

settings.label: Facebook access token
settings.description: An app access token from Meta for Developers, written as the app's ID, a | and its secret. Kept encrypted.

settings.label: Your site's old address
settings.description: If the site moved from another domain, its old address, such as https://old.example.com, so counts made there still count.

settings.label: Pin buttons on images
settings.description: Adds a Pinterest button to the images in an article. Decorative images, and images with an empty description, get none.

settings.label: Smallest image to pin
settings.description: Images narrower than this get no pin button.

settings.label: Pin button corner
settings.description: Where the pin button sits on an image.

settings.label: Let readers pick the image
settings.description: When an article has several images, the Pinterest share button lets the reader choose which one to pin.

settings.label: Highlight to share
settings.description: When a reader selects words in an article, by mouse, touch or keyboard, a small bar offers to share them.

settings.label: Highlight networks
settings.description: What the highlight bar offers.

settings.label: Share buttons on quotes
settings.description: Adds a share button under each quote in an article, so a reader can share the quote's words.

settings.label: Your profiles
settings.description: The site's own profiles, in order. For the site's feed choose RSS and leave the address empty.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: The profile's address, or for email the address to write to.

settings.label: Where follow buttons show
settings.description: Before or after one of your theme's regions on every page, or after each article.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: The region's slug, as your theme names it, such as sidebar or footer.

settings.label: Before or after the region
settings.description: Which side of the region the buttons go.

settings.label: Follow heading
settings.description: A line above the follow buttons. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Add UTM tags
settings.description: Adds utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to shared addresses, so your analytics can tell where visits came from. {network} becomes the network's name.

settings.label: Source
settings.description: utm_source.

settings.label: Medium
settings.description: utm_medium.

settings.label: Campaign
settings.description: utm_campaign.

settings.label: Your X account
settings.description: Named as "via" when someone shares to X, such as @example.

settings.label: Suggested Mastodon server
settings.description: The server readers are offered first when they share to Mastodon. They can type their own, and their device remembers it.

settings.label: Short links
settings.description: Shortens shared addresses with a service you connect. Each article's address is sent to it once. Short links replace the UTM tags.

settings.label: Bitly access token
settings.description: From your Bitly account's settings. Kept encrypted.

actions.label: Bring the article list up to date
actions.description: Reads every published article's title and address now, instead of within the hour.

actions.label: Refresh share counts now
actions.description: Asks the networks you ticked for their counts now.

actions.label: Apply the Novashare settings
actions.description: After importing a WordPress site that used Novashare, saves its settings here. Tools › Jobs then lists what to set by hand.

permissions.description: Which articles and networks are shared most, from Sharely's own counts.
